logger.message: #['[Security] Rejected unsupported carrier webhook request: ' ++ (vars.carrier default 'UNKNOWN')]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Unsupported Carrier Error

set-variable.value: #[attributes.headers['x-carrier-token'] default attributes.headers['X-Carrier-Token'] default attributes.queryParams['x-carrier-token'] default attributes.queryParams['X-Carrier-Token'] default '']
set-variable.doc:name: Get Inbound Token

when.expression: #[(upper(trim(vars.carrier)) == 'BLUEDART' and vars.inboundToken == p('carrier.bluedart.token')) or (upper(trim(vars.carrier)) == 'DELHIVERY' and vars.inboundToken == p('carrier.delhivery.token'))]

logger.doc:name: Log Auth Failure
logger.message: #['[Security] Unauthorized access attempt for carrier: ' ++ (vars.carrier default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' | InboundToken provided: ' ++ (if (isEmpty(vars.inboundToken)) 'NONE' else 'INVALID')]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Unauthorized Error
raise-error.description: Invalid or missing X-Carrier-Token header for carrier webhook.

logger.doc:name: Log Shipment Creation
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Shipments] Registering shipment: ' ++ (vars.newShipment.shipmentId default '') ++ ' | Tracking: ' ++ (vars.newShipment.trackingNumber default '')]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert New Shipment
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO shipments ( shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, origin_location, destination_location, current_status, status_rank, promised_delivery_time, risk_level, risk_reason ) VALUES ( :shipmentId, :trackingNumber, :carrier, :originLocation, :destinationLocation, 'LABEL_CREATED', 10, :promisedDeliveryTime, 'ON_TRACK', 'Shipment manifested. Awaiting carrier pickup.' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE origin_location = VALUES(origin_location), destination_location = VALUES(destination_location), promised_delivery_time = VALUES(promised_delivery_time);
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java fun toSqlDt(val) = if (val == null or (val as String) == "") null else do { var s = (val as String) replace "T" with " " replace "Z" with "" --- if (sizeOf(s) >= 19) s[0 to 18] else s } --- { shipmentId: vars.newShipment.shipmentId, trackingNumber: vars.newShipment.trackingNumber, carrier: vars.newShipment.carrier, originLocation: vars.newShipment.originLocation, destinationLocation: vars.newShipment.destinationLocation, promisedDeliveryTime: toSqlDt(vars.newShipment.promisedDeliveryTime) }]
